context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_bugs.py is the regression suite for iter7 fixes. It (1) hits /api/history/{code} with all six ranges expecting 200 + <=80 points and default range=1G, (2) generates TTS mp3 and round-trips it through /api/ai/transcribe expecting non-empty text, (3) regressions on /api/meta, /api/prices, /api/ai/commentary, /api/ai/chat alarm-intent (creates+deletes USD>100), and /api/ai/portfolio-advice. Frontend: use testIDs range-1s, range-6s, range-12s, range-1G, range-1H, range-1A on /product/{code}, and ai-mic, ai-input, ai-send, ai-speak-{index} on /assistant.
rca_of_issue: BUG1 root cause was Python built-in shadowing: function signature `range: str = ...` shadowed built-in range() used inside list comprehensions for downsampling → HTTP 500. Fixed by renaming to `range_: str = Query('1G', alias='range')` while preserving public query-string API. BUG2 was caused by passing a filesystem path string to OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe() which expects a bytes-like/file object (`Expected entry at file to be bytes... received str`). Fixed by opening the temp file with `open(tmp_path, 'rb')` and passing the file handle. FEATURE3 (auto-speak after voice): send() now accepts autoSpeak flag; voice flow calls send(text, true) and on assistant reply schedules speak(idx, reply) 250ms after state update — verified wiring in assistant.tsx lines 98-126 and 149-172.
